entries.641db0f2abbe7b2c: The medium-term management plan "Make a Leap 2027: Solidify the footing, toward a further leap" (announced on June 25, Reiwa 7; through the fiscal year ending May in Reiwa 10) redefined its mission, vision, and values, and sets as its long-term goals being a dispensing pharmacy group chosen and trusted by local patients and a dispensing pharmacy group that properly stays close to the health maintenance, medical, and nursing care needs particularly of older people. Its growth strategies are strengthening pharmacists' primary-care functions in the dispensing pharmacy business, continuing patient-centered pharmacy operations, thoroughly pursuing efforts toward increasing the number of prescriptions accepted, and, in other items, advancing M&A responses, restructuring existing businesses other than the dispensing pharmacy business, and promoting sustainability. The medium-term plan period is positioned as a period for solidifying its footing through early completion of PMI for companies and stores that have newly joined the group. The plan's target figures are matters concerning the future, so they are not transcribed here.
